constraints.evidence: Every measured dynamic endpoint had one source-version regression in the retained 48-hour campaign summary.
Version gaps were common: 4685 missing-version counts across 52 of 53 dynamic endpoints.
No source lastUpdated regression was measured across 7637 dynamic body-bearing representations.
Unknown-code diagnostics occurred on 14 dynamic endpoints and must not imply quarantine by themselves.

limitations: The retained M4 measurement summary contains endpoint-level transport/parser aggregates, not per-representation map item/team/icon composition.
M4 therefore constrains blocking effects for version/taxonomy signals but cannot provide population quantiles for NONE share, item-count collapse, or icon-composition collapse.
Composition thresholds in policy@2 are conservative regression-fixture guardrails rather than universal source-distribution estimates.
